internal.title: Incident Report: High Latency in Ad Service Due to High CPU Usage
internal.body:
At 10:36 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert for high latency was triggered on the ad service. Diagnosis identified very high CPU utilization (0.98) coinciding with increased latency and error rates. The root cause was linked to the activation of the adHighCpu feature flag, known to cause high CPU usage. The flag was disabled at 10:56 UTC, leading to verified recovery with normalized error ratios. The incident was resolved promptly with no lasting impact on service availability.

Timeline:
- 10:36:45: Alert received for high latency
- 10:56:25: Diagnosis confirmed high CPU usage linked to adHighCpu flag
- 10:56:27: Flag disabled
- 10:56:27: Recovery verified with stable error ratios

Action Taken:
- Disabled the adHighCpu feature flag

Impact:
- Temporary increase in latency and error rates for the ad service

Resolution:
- Disabling the problematic feature flag restored normal service performance.

Lessons Learned:
- Feature flags that significantly impact resource usage must be closely monitored.
- Rapid diagnosis and rollback procedures are critical for minimizing impact.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
